opportunities.title: Research Project Grants – Detailed Applications
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities and other higher education institutions (and trial UK independent research institutes) may apply; principal investigator must be employed by the eligible institution.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £500,000 for innovative research projects of up to five years, covering staff costs, research expenses and associated costs.

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Host academic must be based at a UK university with research degree awarding powers; must coordinate the visit.
opportunities.summary: Funds visits by eminent overseas professors (3‑12 months) to bring novel expertise to UK institutions, with awards between £10k‑£150k.

opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: Up to £56,000 salary contribution in year 1, up to £28,000 in years 2‑3; up to £6,000 per year for research expenses.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers who have not yet held a full‑time permanent academic post, hold a doctorate, and meet specific viva and career‑break criteria.
opportunities.summary: Supports early‑career scholars to undertake a significant piece of publishable research for three years, covering salary and research expenses.

opportunities.title: Major Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Salary costs for two‑ or three‑year fellowship; research expenses up to £6,000 per year.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established researchers in humanities or social sciences employed at a UK university with research degree awarding powers.
opportunities.summary: Provides salary support for distinguished researchers to complete original research, with up to £6,000 per year for research expenses.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards

amount.raw: Up to £1,000,000 for staff salaries and associated costs.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career scholars with a permanent UK university appointment (lecturer level or equivalent) who have at least two years post‑PhD experience and have not previously led a research team.
opportunities.summary: Supports talented early‑career academics to build and lead a modest research team, delivering transformative research over 4‑5 years.
discipline_tags: All disciplines (excluding medical/clinical, policy‑driven, advocacy, commercial)

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Retired UK university researchers (or eligible independent research organisations) who have lived in the UK ≥26 weeks/year and have an established research record.
opportunities.summary: Provides modest funding for retired scholars to complete or integrate research outputs, with awards of £3k‑£24k for 3‑24 months.

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Experienced researchers holding a UK university post (research degree awarding powers), resident in the UK, with teaching/administrative duties that have limited research time.
opportunities.summary: Supports experienced researchers to complete a piece of research, with awards up to £70k for 3‑24 months.
